## Goal
Every merge to main deploys to dev automatically via OIDC; prod promotion needs the owner's approval.

## Owns
- `infra/cdk/bin/**`
- `infra/cdk/lib/github-oidc-stack.ts`
- `infra/cdk/lib/paths.ts`
- `infra/cdk/lib/lambda.ts`
- `infra/cdk/package.json`
- `infra/cdk/cdk.json`
- `infra/cdk/tsconfig.json`
- `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`
- `scripts/secrets/**`

## Tests first (write them, see them fail, then implement)
- A CDK assertion test for GithubOidcStack: trust is limited to repo:<repo>:environment:<env> and aud sts.amazonaws.com.

## Steps
- cdk bootstrap dev and prod (owner runs the command you prepare).
- Deploy ai1145-github-oidc with -c repo=<owner>/<repo>; store role ARNs as repo variables.
- Make deploy.yml deploy all stacks on main, then call e2e.yml; prod job uses the protected environment.
- scripts/secrets/push.sh: .env -> GitHub secrets and Secrets Manager (names from docs/API_KEYS.md).

## Acceptance
- A merged no-op PR deploys to dev within 20 minutes with no long-lived AWS keys in GitHub.

## Run
`cd infra/cdk && pnpm tsc -p tsconfig.json` and `make test` before opening the PR.
